notes.md.text:
# Install notes

The installer reads its package list from the local mirror before it tries anything over the network, and stops if the mirror is missing.
Run it twice on a fresh machine: the first run writes the cache, and the second run checks that every file it wrote is still there.

The full guide:

https://example.org/handbook/installation/offline-mirrors/configuring-a-local-package-index-step-by-step
